Physical examination revealed two distinct masses on the right scalp, with the larger one being fungating, tender, and prone to bleeding. A CT scan showed a large multilobulated ulcerative scalp lesion (9 × 7.8 × 6 cm) without skull bone erosion or intracranial extension.
